description: This file provides utility functions for user authentication using Supabase, including sign-up, sign-in, password reset, OAuth sign-in, sign-out, updating password, and error handling. It manages redirect URLs for different authentication flows and exports functions for use within a React frontend project.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Register a new user with email and password, with redirect options for email verification.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Authenticate a user using email and password.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Send a password reset email with a specific redirect URL.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Authenticate a user using a magic link (OTP) via email.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Sign in using an OAuth provider with redirect URL handling.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Sign out the current authenticated user.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handle authentication errors and provide user feedback with toast notifications and redirects.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieve the current authenticated user's information.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description: Retrieve the current authentication session information.
